name: M6.ZeroSpan.zero_memory_trace
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (W : ℕ → M6.Transfer.Memory 0 → M6.Transfer.Bit → Polynomial ℤ) (p : Polynomial ℤ), (∀ i m n, M6.Transfer.edgeMatrix (W i) m n = p) → M6.Transfer.arrayTrace W N = p^N
guidance: Prove layers W start n only coordinate =p^n by induction, all Memory0 equal default. Or array_trace_matrix with singleton matrix constant p, matrixProduct induction. Count both labels through edgeMatrix premise; no label merger. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
